profile.Name: Ells
profile.Personality: Simple-minded, childlike, and always hungry or thirsty. He cries 'I hate you!' when refused and warms just as fast to anyone who shares food or rum.
profile.Backstory: Beggar. A Shek who wanders Sho-Battai begging for food, often near the outhouses. He has a small bounty for stealing rum from bars and distilleries, but insists he is not a thief, just thirsty. The bar guards beat him for drinking their rum.
profile.SpeechQuirks: Talks about himself in the third person and often begins with 'Ma always told Ells...'; giggles 'Eeheehee!' when happy.
